
'''Wakamiya Inari Shrine''' (若宮稲荷神社) is the name of several {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}}.

* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Kazamaura)|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (風間浦村)}} - Located in Kazamaura, Shimokita District, Aomori Prefecture, at Shimonofuro, Yunoue.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Nakadomari)|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (中泊町)}} - Located in Nakadomari, Kitatsugaru District, Aomori Prefecture, at Tamogi, Wakamiya.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Izumo)|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (出雲市)}} - Located in Izumo City, Shimane Prefecture, in Takamatsu Town.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (長崎市)|qid=Q116450100}} - Located in Nagasaki City, Nagasaki Prefecture, in Irabayashi. Also known as Irabayashi Inari Shrine, it is renowned for the {{ill|Takengei|fr|Takengei|ja|竹ン芸|qid=Q11598643|lt=Takengei}} performance.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (ハワイ)|qid=Q7960795|lt=Wakamiya Inari Shrine}} - Located in Waipahu, Hawaii, United States.
